# Onibex eCommerce 360° Documentation

> Bilingual (English/Spanish) technical documentation of Onibex eCommerce 360°, the B2B/B2C eCommerce platform designed for use with SAP ERP: ALE/IDoc configuration guides for SAP ERP (logical system, RFC destination, IDoc port, partner profiles, change pointers, MATMAS, DEBMAS, ORDERS, ORDRSP, DESADV, INVOIC, custom quotation/contract/transport IDocs), SICF web services, cross-selling configuration, the complete list of custom objects created in SAP ERP, and FAQ articles for the store administration panel. Licensed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (noncommercial sharing with attribution; commercial license available).

Published by Onibex, LLC (https://www.onibex.com). The same content is available in the Onibex Help Center (https://help.onibex.com/portal/en/kb/ecommerce360). Each document exists in English (`en/`) and Spanish (`es/`) with the same path. SAP and other SAP products and services mentioned herein are trademarks or registered trademarks of SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company in Germany and other countries. PrestaShop is a trademark of PrestaShop SA. Names are used for identification only.
